symptom: Chat-learning policy and AGENTS preflight instructions can be present while the central Agent Fabric still permits FixPrepared or WaitingApproval to transition into Executing without a verified READY learning packet.
rootCause: A documentation or caller-discipline contract is advisory unless the existing runtime owner enforces the same invariant at the material execution boundary.
failedApproach: Rely on AGENTS.md or individual callers to remember the preflight, or create a second execution gateway or parallel memory store to compensate.
provenFix: Gate FixPrepared/WaitingApproval -> Executing inside the existing Agent Fabric on BRAIN-CHAT-LEARNING-PREFLIGHT-v1; fail closed on missing provider, provider failure, incompatible version or invalid source-hash evidence, and wire the canonical compiler through createDefaultAgentFabric.
prevention: Every material AgentWork execution must pass the canonical READY chat-learning preflight in the existing Agent Fabric owner; intake and read-only investigation may continue, but execution cannot. Persist only compact contract/version/source-hash/fingerprint evidence and never duplicate the memory or execution truth.
evidence: RED: Shared Agent Memory proved execution succeeded without a preflight before the runtime gate existed.
GREEN: Shared Agent Memory proved missing/provider/version failures block before mutation and READY stores only compact evidence.
GREEN: createDefaultAgentFabric automatically injects the canonical filesystem-bounded compiler.
